args.subject: Private dining reservation request for 12 people
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I am writing to request a private dining reservation for a party of 12 people next Friday. 

Could you please availability and options for a private dining experience for our group? We would appreciate information about:
- Available time slots
- Menu options for groups
- Any special requirements or considerations for a party of 12
- Pricing details

Please let me know what dates and times are available, and any additional information I should provide to secure this reservation.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
